content.text: No non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding the Customer exists anywhere in the agreement, and § 12.3 affirmatively confirms that position.

input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "hire", "employ" and a review of the likely locations (§ 30 General, § 12 Customer Responsibilities, § 16 Confidentiality) show no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding Northwind. § 12.3 goes further and expressly preserves our freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that we have made no no-hire commitment. The only forward-looking restriction in § 12 (12.4, non-compete on competing analytics services) binds Vendor and benefits us, so it is not flagged. This matches the preferred position of no non-solicit on Customer; no redline is required.
